newsitem.title: USA: Unit reserves up, E&P effort expanded.
newsitem.headline: Unit reserves up, E&P effort expanded.

text.p: Unit Corp said Tuesday it replaced 216 percent of its 1996 production resulting in a 13.5 percent increase in the company's proved reserves.
Unit also said its exploration and production budget for 1997 is expected to exceed $31 million, a more than 20 percent increase over 1996.
The company said it expects 1997 to be the 14th year in a row when it will replace more than 150 percent of its current year production.

The company said the present value at a discount rate of 10 percent of these reserves as of December 31 is almost $264 million. This value is based on average prices realized in December of $24.57 per barrel of oil and at $3.63 per thousand cubic feet of natural gas.

Unit said net proved reserves as of December 31 were 5.2 million barrels of oil and 129.2 billion cubic feet of natural gas. The majority of the reserves added in 1996 were the result of the participation in 72 wells.

Unit produced a record 16.5 billion cubic feet equivalent during 1996, a 6 percent increase over 1995. Unit's 1996 average daily production was 1,581 barrels of oil and 35.6 million cubic feet of natural gas.
